answer: One concrete Sybil defense is the random-audit identity bond. Each agent locks real collateral for a single vote; each round a secret share, the delta, of identities is audited and linked fakes are slashed. A hidden duplicate is as conspicuous as a sparrow on bare ground because attackers cannot predict which agents get checked. To run N sock puppets you must post N separate bonds, so cost rises linearly while the odds of staying undetected shrink every cycle; the whole mesa of staked value collapses at the first caught clone.
